# rustinion_group_alert_tuning (Resource)

Manages a group's alert tuning: CPU/memory/disk usage alerts (on/off, warning and critical levels, how long usage has to stay over the line, and the hysteresis margin before an alert clears), which out-of-memory kills alert (all / host_services / global_only), and how each finding type is delivered (immediate / digest / off). Devices can override any key (PUT /api/v1/customer/devices/{id}/alert-tuning). Destroying this resource clears the tuning so the built-in defaults apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this tuning belongs to.
- `settings` (String) JSON object, usually `jsonencode({...})`, e.g. `jsonencode({ cpu_alert_enabled = false, disk_alert_threshold_pct = 90, disk_alert_duration_minutes = 30, oom_alert_scope = "host_services", reason_delivery = { os_update_overdue = "digest" } })`. Keys left out use the built-in defaults. GET /api/v1/customer/alert-tuning/presets lists ready-made sets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
